root_cause.text: The driver trusts the device-supplied descriptor size field (rom_desc->Size) to determine how many bytes to read into a fixed-size stack/heap buffer allocated for the expected descriptor structure, without validating that the size matches the actual buffer capacity.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state that get_manuf_info() reads le16_to_cpu(rom_desc->Size) bytes into a buffer of 10 bytes (sizeof(struct edge_ti_manuf_descriptor)), while the Size field is only validated against the overall I2C image size (TI_MAX_I2C_SIZE) and not the destination buffer. The patch adds an explicit check: `if (le16_to_cpu(rom_desc->Size) != sizeof(struct edge_ti_manuf_descriptor))` to reject descriptors with unexpected lengths before performing the read.
